# artisanvirt_vm (Data Source)

Looks up a VM by id or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "artisanvirt_vm" "db" {
  name = "db01"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) VM id. Exactly one of `id` or `name` is required.
- `name` (String) VM name.

### Read-Only

- `autostart` (Boolean)
- `cluster_id` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `firmware` (String) `bios` or `uefi`.
- `gpu_address` (String) Assigned GPU PCI address, if any.
- `last_error` (String)
- `mac_addresses` (List of String) NIC MACs in order.
- `memory_mib` (Number)
- `node_id` (String) Host node.
- `snapshots` (List of String) Snapshot names.
- `state` (String) VM state.
- `tags` (Map of String)
- `uuid` (String) libvirt UUID.
- `vcpus` (Number)
